silvervein_frac | location = [[Mountain]] | durability = 40 | tool tier = 2 | resistances = pickaxe only }} '''Silver Veins''' are resource nodes found in tall [[Mountain|Mountains]]. They drop [[Silver Ore]] and [[Stone]] when mined with an [[Iron Pickaxe]] or better. Veins can be detected by equipping the [[Wishbone]]. The Wishbone will emit a tone along with colored particles from the player when a vein is nearby. The tone becomes higher-pitched and faster the closer the player is to the vein. Alternatively, the player can hit the terrain at random positions with [[Stagbreaker]] or an [[Iron Sledge]] until a "Too hard" message is seen under the ground, this is known as [[How to play#How_to_prospect_properly?|Prospecting]]. [[Stagbreaker]] is much more accurate than [[Iron Sledge]] for locating silver in the [[Mountain|Mountains]]. While slower, this does not require killing [[Bonemass]]. == Spawning == The world generator attempts 50 times to find a suitable position for a single vein on every [[Zones|zone]]. The spawn position must have the following conditions: * [[Mountain]] biome * At least 120 meter altitude * Up to 30 degree terrain angle * 10 random points within nine meters have up to a three-meter altitude difference If successful, the vein is placed four meters under the ground. == Drops == Silver Veins always have the same Y-shaped layout with 100 nodes with 40 HP each. Each of the nodes may drop: {{loot table| {{loot row|item=Silver Ore|amt=2-3|rate=33.3%}} {{loot row|item=Stone|amt=2-3|rate=66.7%}} }} On average, one silver vein will produce about 83.3 silver ore and about 166.7 stone. == Notes == * Metal deposits do not respawn. * Like other metals, silver ore cannot be teleported. * Silver Veins sometimes intersect with nearby stone, but can be mined after the stone is removed. * [[Drake]]s and [[obsidian]] require 100 meter altitude to spawn. These can be used to measure the mountain height. * Veins are more likely to appear completely underground on even terrain. However, the random check allows them also to be placed on uneven terrain, which can leave them naturally exposed. * Veins can be mined instantly by removing all supporting ground and then mining a single node. Once the first node breaks all others will follow. This will give all resources instantly but will not give additional [[Pickaxes (Skill)|Pickaxes]] experience. == Gallery == 20210316141925 1.jpg|A silver vein Silver Ore.jpg ValheimSilverVein.jpg 20210325185903 1.jpg|Two silver veins overlapping 20210326202204 1.jpg|A silver vein naturally protruding from the ground SilverVein.png 3.png|Three connected silver ore veins {{WorldNav}} [[cs:Ložisko stříbra]] [[ru:Залежи серебра]]

'''Pickaxes''' is a [[Skills|skill]] related to [[Pickaxes]] weapon class.

==Effects==
Higher skill level in pickaxes reduces the [[Stamina#Attacking|stamina]] cost to attack down to -33% and uses a random damage and knockback multiplier ranging from 25–55% at skill level 0 to 85–100% at skill level 100 against creatures and ores.

For the details of damage scaling, see [[Damage mechanics#Skill factor]].

==Leveling up==
The player gains 1.5[[Skills#Progression|xp]] per attack when hitting stone or ore deposits.

'''Damage''' is a reduction of an entity's health points. It affects much of the core gameplay mechanics. Almost every entity, object, or structure utilizes this system in some way. __NOTOC__ ==Damage types== *Physical **[[Damage#Blunt|Blunt]] **[[Damage#Pierce|Pierce]] **[[Damage#Slash|Slash]] *Elemental **[[Damage#Fire|Fire]] **[[Damage#Poison|Poison]] **[[Damage#Frost|Frost]] **[[Damage#Spirit|Spirit]] **[[Damage#Lightning|Lightning]] *Terrain **[[Damage#Chop|Chop]] (Woodcutting) **[[Damage#Pickaxe|Pickaxe]] (Mining) **[[Damage#Pure|Pure]] ==Resistances and weaknesses== {{See also|Resistance}} Resistances and weaknesses determine how much damage is taken from different [[damage types]]. [[Creatures]] have innate resistances and weaknesses but are also affected by some [[status effects]]. Players may acquire resistances and weaknesses from [[armor]], [[Mead|meads]] or [[status effects]]. [[#Creature Resistance Matrix|At the bottom]] of this page is a chart of creature Weaknesses, Resistances and Immunities. '''Chain lightning''' is an on-hit effect triggered by weapons upgraded with [[Iolite]] or [[Thunderblood Essence]].

==Effect==
Chain lightning has a 25% chance to trigger on a normal attack and a 20% chance to trigger on a secondary attack.

It deals 75 [[lightning]] damage to the target, the amount is not affected by skills, and it cannot be blocked or dodged.

Once triggered, it has an 80% chance of bouncing off nearby enemies or players. If so, each nearby target within 8 meters has a 30% chance of being targeted, up to a maximum of 2–4 targets per bounce (the maximum is chosen at random then targets are processed starting from the nearest). The process repeats indefinitely, centered on each new target, but with the chance of rebound multiplied by 0.75 each time (i.e., 80% → 60% → 45% → 33.75%, etc.).

A single activation of chain lightning cannot affect the same target more than once.

==Notes==
* Chain lightning within the vicinity of neutral [[Ashlands Dvergr]] has the potential of damaging them, immediately turning them hostile.
